description: issue #681 (slice I2), the WORD half of the number-vs-word rule: `spec/interaction-events.md:136-137` — "Otherwise it returns a word preserving the entered text." The same program shape as `input-number-answer` with a non-numeral answer: `"tom"` is reported as the word `tom`, so `word "hello " :answer` concatenates to `hello tom`. Together the two fixtures pin BOTH branches of the rule against one another, so an implementation that always reported a word (or always tried to make a number) fails exactly one of them. This is also the spec's own worked example (`spec/interaction-events.md:139-142`).
